arStrings.szText: "Won't the Cathedral be upset that we're digging up this place?"
Probably. But I’ll prove to them that they need me.
If you’re going to be my ally in this, you deserve to know the truth. About me.
My Knights Penitent detachment was beset by a demon horde. My comrades fought valiantly, but I was the lone survivor.
The Cathedral accused me of cowardice, of fleeing while my brothers in arms were slaughtered.
But I swear to you and to Inarius himself, that’s not what happened. I fought, we all did, but I was the only Knight left standing.
If only I had been able to do more to protect my brethren. That’s what haunts me.
The Cathedral excommunicated me. So I am as you see me. Alone.
